title: Handy's four cultures
caption: Each culture has a picture and a trade-off: the power culture is fast but depends on one person, the role culture is stable but slow, the task culture is flexible but costly.
alt: Four boxes: power culture (a spider's web), role culture (a Greek temple), task culture (a net), person culture (barristers' chambers).
description: Power culture: a central figure controls, like a spider's web.
Role culture: rules and procedures, like a Greek temple.
Task culture: teams form around projects, like a net.
Person culture: the organisation serves individuals, such as a barristers' chambers.

blocks.label: Power culture
blocks.note: Spider's web: a central figure controls. Fast, but depends on one person.

blocks.label: Role culture
blocks.note: Greek temple: rules and procedures. Stable but slow.

blocks.label: Task culture
blocks.note: Net: teams form around projects. Flexible and expert-led; costly.

blocks.label: Person culture
blocks.note: The organisation serves individuals, as in barristers' chambers.
